Live-confirmed: ide=200 (real bundle bytes, sets oxy_custom_app_session cookie), both serve replicas=404 (silent, no error logged: NotFound -> Ok(None) -> cached absence). Asserted here on purpose -- expect this assertion to FAIL until either the fleet fixture configures a bucket or the FS fallback gets a current_process_role() guard like the DuckDB s3_mirror path already has.
